title: Assistant models
description: The providers the assistant can call and the models on them, with the tags a task asks for and a priority.

providers.description: Where models run. An Ollama endpoint may be on this machine or on another one in the network. Fields per type: ollama - base_url (required), api_key_from (compulsory key, empty allowed); openai - base_url (required), api_key_from (compulsory key, empty allowed); anthropic - base_url (optional, default https://api.anthropic.com), api_key_from (compulsory key; a credential is needed); vertex - project and location (required), api_key_from (compulsory key; a credential is needed); demo - none. Every type but demo also takes the optional headers.

models.description: The models a call can be routed to.

routing.description: How a model that keeps failing is set aside.

failures.description: Consecutive failures after which a model is unavailable. Default 3.

cooldown_seconds.description: How long it stays unavailable. Default 60.

rate_limited_cooldown_seconds.description: How long it stays unavailable after a rate limit (429). Default 30.

type.description: Kind of provider: ollama, vertex (Google), openai (any OpenAI-compatible chat API, such as OpenAI or OpenRouter), anthropic (the Anthropic Messages API), or demo.

project.description: Google Cloud project that bills a vertex provider, e.g. my-project.

location.description: Region of a vertex provider, e.g. us-central1, or global.

base_url.description: Where the provider answers, without credentials, e.g. http://localhost:11434. Required for ollama and openai; an openai provider is called at {base_url}/chat/completions, e.g. https://openrouter.ai/api/v1. Optional for anthropic, which is called at {base_url}/v1/messages and defaults to https://api.anthropic.com.

api_key_from.description: Where the provider's API key or access token comes from. The key is compulsory on every provider except demo, but its value may be empty. Accepted: an empty string (no credential), env:NAME (the environment variable NAME, never the secret itself) or file:/absolute/path (the file's content, trimmed of whitespace, such as a mounted secret or a refreshed token). A file: is re-read on every call, so a changed file needs no restart; an env: variable is read from the process environment, which a running process does not see change, so a changed variable needs a restart. Optional in effect on ollama (sent as a Bearer key to a server behind an authenticating proxy) and openai (sent as a Bearer key; empty for a local server). Needed on anthropic (sent as the x-api-key header) and vertex (sent as a Bearer OAuth access token): without a credential those providers are skipped, with the reason missing_credentials, until one is present.

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers sent on every request to the provider, as header name -> value; allowed on every type but demo. A value is env:NAME (the environment variable, read from the process environment: a restart is needed to see a change), file:/absolute/path (the file's content, trimmed of whitespace, re-read on every call) or else a literal value (a literal that must start with env: or file: cannot be written). Sent after the provider's own headers, so they may replace a default such as anthropic-version. Not allowed: authorization and x-api-key (use api_key_from), content-type, content-length, host, connection, transfer-encoding. Header names are case-insensitive and may not repeat. A header from env: or file: that has no value makes the provider skipped, like a missing credential. Names and values are never shown in the admin UI, API or logs.

id.description: Name of this entry in logs, records and metrics.

provider.description: The id of the provider it runs on.

model.description: The provider's own name for the model, e.g. gemma4:12b.

tags.description: What the model is good for: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter. A task asks for tags; only models that have all of them are candidates.

priority.description: Higher is tried first. Zero or more.

options.description: Settings for this model; a provider ignores the ones that do not apply to it. num_ctx, think, first_token_timeout_seconds and idle_timeout_seconds are Ollama-only; num_predict (most tokens in a reply: max_tokens for openai and anthropic, which defaults to 16000, and the output limit for vertex and ollama) and overall_timeout_seconds apply to every provider.

think.description: Let a thinking-capable model reason first; slow.

first_token_timeout_seconds.description: Wait for the first token, which covers loading the model.

idle_timeout_seconds.description: Longest pause between tokens once they flow.

overall_timeout_seconds.description: Longest a whole call may take.

price.description: US dollars per million tokens; both default to 0 (a local model costs nothing).
